home.hero: Legal and psychosocial support near you
home.sub: Normalizer connects people with verified legal, psychology and social-work professionals. Find someone to help you, book an appointment and get clear guidance.
home.how_1_desc: Your mode adapts automatically: content and interface tailored for children, adults or older people.
home.how_2_desc: Search by type of professional, specialty, language and experience, on the map or in the list.
home.how_3_desc: Schedule a visit, call or video call, or ask Ramon, your answers assistant.
home.ql_especialistas: Verified lawyers, psychologists, social workers, translators and paralegals.
home.ql_mapa: Find geolocated professionals and filter by language, specialty and distance.
home.ql_comunidad: Share experiences, read topics and find support in the forum.
home.ql_emergencias: Direct access to Police, Firefighters and medical emergencies, plus local support services.
home.modes_hint: The app adapts to your age: each mode shows appropriate content and interface.
home.about_body: Normalizer is a legal-access platform that brings together lawyers, psychologists, social workers, translators and paralegals in one place. All profiles are reviewed and approved by an administrator before going public, and every appointment is scheduled without double-booking.
home.trust_verified_desc: Every profile is reviewed and approved by administration before being published.
home.trust_ramon_desc: Answers your questions instantly with clear responses and links you to related content.
home.trust_support_desc: Emergency numbers and local support services always one tap away.
